nodes.description: MBDAAsset.admin: privileged address checked in onlyAdmin/boardOrAdmin/managerOrAdmin modifiers and used to redirect transfers to the contract itself.
MBDAAsset.board: address allowed (with admin) to call setBlockLock and replaceAdmin via boardOrAdmin.
MBDAAsset.manager: address allowed to mint/burn via managerOrAdmin; set by onlyAdmin.
MBDAAsset.lockedUntilBlock: block number until which transfers are blocked by the blockLock modifier / isLocked().
MBDAAsset.balances: token balance mapping written by transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn.
MBDAAsset.allowed: ERC20 allowance mapping written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
MBDAAsset.totalSupply: total token supply, increased in mint and decreased in burn.
MBDAAsset.clearedInvestors: whitelist/syndicate registry consulted by isTransferValid.
MBDAWallet.controllers: mapping checked by onlyController modifier; mutated by newController/deleteController.
MBDAWalletFactory.walletsIDMap: mapping from recipientExternalID to Wallet struct, written in CreateWallet.
MBDAManager.contractsMap: mapping of deployed fund token address to FundTokenContract struct.
MbdaBoard.proposals: proposal storage including votes, executed flag, payload and success data.
MbdaBoard.proposalTypes: mapping from proposal type name to bytes4 function selector, written by addProposalType/removeProposalType.
MbdaBoard.minVotes: quorum of votes needed to execute a proposal; compared in vote().
MbdaBoard.boardMembers: mapping checked by onlyBoardMember; mutated by addBoardMember/removeBoardMember.
msg.sender as seen by MBDAAsset functions: drives admin/board/manager authorization and the 'from' account on transfers.
msg.sender as seen by MBDAWallet functions: drives the onlyController authorization check.
msg.sender as seen by MbdaBoard functions: drives onlyBoardMember authorization and voter bookkeeping.
MBDAAsset.transfer(address,uint256): blockLock-guarded ERC20 transfer, converts admin sender into the contract address.
MBDAAsset.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): allowance plus validity checked transfer that decrements allowed.
MBDAAsset.approve(address,uint256): sets allowance, admin approved as the contract itself.
MBDAAsset.mint(address,uint256): onlyIfMintable + managerOrAdmin + blockLock mint increasing totalSupply.
MBDAAsset.burn(address payable,uint256): payable burn that forwards msg.value to the account with a low-level call.
MBDAAsset.replaceAdmin(address): boardOrAdmin function overwriting the admin state variable.
MBDAAsset.setManager(address): onlyAdmin function overwriting the manager state variable.
MBDAAsset.setBlockLock(uint256): boardOrAdmin function overwriting lockedUntilBlock.
MBDAAsset.isTransferValid(address,address,uint256): view that combines balance, white-list and syndicate checks.
MBDAAsset.isLocked(): view comparing lockedUntilBlock with the current block number.
MBDAWallet.withdrawEther(address payable,uint256): onlyController ether withdrawal via low-level call without state bookkeeping.
MBDAWallet.newController(address): onlyController addition of a controller to the mapping and array.
MBDAWallet.deleteController(address): onlyController removal of a controller with array swap/pop loop.
MBDAWallet.transfer(address,address,uint256): onlyController external call into an arbitrary token contract.
MBDAWalletFactory.CreateWallet(address,string): deploys a new MBDAWallet and registers it against recipientExternalID.
MBDAManager.newFund(...): deploys a new MBDAAsset fund token and records it in contracts/contractsMap.
MbdaBoard.addProposal(string,bytes,address payable,uint256): onlyBoardMember creation of a proposal that auto-votes.
MbdaBoard.vote(uint256): onlyBoardMember vote incrementing the uint8 votes counter and triggering execution at quorum.
MbdaBoard.executeProposal(uint256): internal execution that prefixes the stored selector and performs a low-level call with value.
MbdaBoard.addBoardMember(address): onlyBoard addition of a board member and minVotes adjustment.
MbdaBoard.removeBoardMember(address): onlyBoard removal of a board member and minVotes clamping.
MbdaBoard.addProposalType(string,bytes4): onlyBoard registration of an allowed function selector for proposals.
Low-level call (bool success,) = _account.call{value: msg.value}("") inside burn, sending ether to an arbitrary payable account.
Low-level call (bool success,) = _beneficiary.call{value: _amount}("") inside withdrawEther, forwarding ether before any balance bookkeeping.
Low-level call prop.destination.call{value: prop.value}(payload) inside executeProposal: unrestricted target and calldata chosen by the proposal.
External call mbda.transfer(_recipient,_amount) on an attacker-supplied token address inside MBDAWallet.transfer.
Unchecked arithmetic: proposals[_proposalID].votes++ uses a uint8 counter and totalProposals++ has no overflow guard.
Parameter _to of MBDAAsset.transfer: destination address of the token transfer.
Parameter _value of MBDAAsset.transfer: amount moved between balances.
Parameter _from of MBDAAsset.transferFrom: source account debited by the transfer.
Parameter _spender of MBDAAsset.approve: account granted the allowance.
Parameter _account of MBDAAsset.burn: payable account that is debited and receives msg.value.
Parameter _beneficiary of MBDAWallet.withdrawEther: destination of the ether low-level call.
Parameter _amount of MBDAWallet.withdrawEther: ether amount checked against address(this).balance.
Parameter _recipient of MBDAWallet.transfer: address passed to the external token transfer.
Parameter _assetAddress of MBDAWallet.transfer: token contract address cast to MBDAAsset.
Local variable 'from' in MBDAAsset.transfer: admin is mapped to address(this) before balance updates.
Local boolean 'success' in MBDAAsset.burn capturing the result of the value call.
Parameter _controller of MBDAWallet.newController: candidate controller address.
Parameter _type of MbdaBoard.addProposal: proposal type looked up in proposalTypes.
Parameter _proposalID of MbdaBoard.vote: index into the proposals mapping.
Local variable 'prop' in MbdaBoard.executeProposal: memory copy of the proposal whose data builds the payload.
Parameter _fundManager of MBDAManager.newFund: admin/manager of the newly deployed token.
Parameter recipientExternalID of MBDAWalletFactory.CreateWallet: key used in walletsIDMap.
Parameter _newMember of MbdaBoard.addBoardMember: address added to boardMembers.
Parameter _id of MbdaBoard.addProposalType: name mapped to a function selector.
Parameter _signature of MbdaBoard.addProposalType: bytes4 selector that will be executed by proposals.
Local variable 'newWallet' in MBDAWalletFactory.CreateWallet: freshly deployed MBDAWallet instance.
Parameter _destination of MbdaBoard.addProposal: target of the later low-level call.
Parameter _value of MbdaBoard.addProposal: ether value attached to the later low-level call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against admin in the onlyAdmin/boardOrAdmin/managerOrAdmin modifiers of MBDAAsset.
msg.sender is compared against board in boardOrAdmin.
msg.sender is compared against manager in managerOrAdmin.
msg.sender becomes the transfer source when the sender is the admin (address(this) fallback).
msg.sender is the spender key used in allowed[_from][msg.sender] and the allowance decrement.
msg.sender determines the approval owner (admin approves as the contract).
msg.sender must satisfy managerOrAdmin to mint new supply.
msg.sender must satisfy managerOrAdmin to burn balances and forward value.
msg.sender must satisfy boardOrAdmin to replace the admin.
msg.sender must satisfy onlyAdmin to set the manager.
msg.sender must satisfy boardOrAdmin to change the block lock.
MBDAWallet onlyController checks controllers[msg.sender] before any privileged action.
msg.sender must be a controller to withdraw ether.
msg.sender must be a controller and cannot add itself.
msg.sender must be a controller to remove a controller.
msg.sender must be a controller to move wallet tokens.
MbdaBoard onlyBoardMember checks boardMembers[msg.sender].
msg.sender must be a board member to create a proposal.
msg.sender must be a board member and is recorded in the voters mapping.
transfer debits balances[from] and credits balances[_to].
_to is used as the creditor key of balances.
_value is the amount subtracted and added to balances.
local 'from' is derived from msg.sender/admin and used for validation and debiting.
'from' is the debited account in balances[from] = balances[from].sub(_value).
_from is the account whose allowance and balance are checked.
transferFrom moves value between balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_spender is the key written in allowed[from][_spender].
approve overwrites the allowance entry in the allowed mapping.
mint credits balances[_to] with the new tokens.
mint increases totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
_account is debited and is the recipient of the forwarded value.
burn subtracts from balances[_account].
burn decreases totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.
burn performs a low-level call forwarding msg.value to _account when value is present.
the value call returns the 'success' boolean that is required to be true.
replaceAdmin overwrites the admin state variable, transferring full protocol control.
setManager overwrites the manager state variable, granting mint/burn rights.
setBlockLock writes the lockedUntilBlock used by the blockLock modifier.
isTransferValid reads balances[_from] to check sufficient funds.
isTransferValid reads clearedInvestors for white-list and syndicate checks.
isLocked compares lockedUntilBlock with the current block number.
_beneficiary is the target of the ether low-level call.
_amount is validated against address(this).balance before the call.
withdrawEther sends ether with a low-level call and only validates success afterwards.
A contract beneficiary can re-enter withdrawEther because no state is updated before the call; protection relies only on the controller check.
newController sets controllers[_controller] = true, expanding privileged membership.
_controller is the address granted controller rights.
deleteController clears controllers[_controller], removing privileged membership.
_recipient is forwarded to the external token transfer.
_assetAddress is cast to MBDAAsset and called externally.
MBDAWallet.transfer delegates the asset movement to an arbitrary token contract.
A malicious token can re-enter the wallet controller functions during the external transfer call.
CreateWallet deploys the new MBDAWallet into the local newWallet variable.
recipientExternalID is the mapping key used to prevent duplicate wallets.
the deployed wallet address is stored in walletsIDMap[recipientExternalID].
newFund records the deployed fund token in contractsMap.
_fundManager becomes the admin of the newly created MBDAAsset.
_type is validated against the proposalTypes mapping.
_destination is stored in the proposal and later used as the call target.
_value is stored in the proposal and later attached to the call.
addProposal writes the new Proposal struct into the proposals mapping.
addProposal automatically casts the proposer's vote by calling vote(proposalID).
vote increments votes and sets voters[msg.sender] on the stored proposal.
vote compares the accumulated votes against minVotes to reach quorum.
_proposalID selects the proposal entry that is voted on.
when votes >= minVotes the vote function calls executeProposal.
vote performs the unchecked uint8 increment proposals[_proposalID].votes++.
the unchecked counter increments mutate the votes field of the proposals mapping.
executeProposal loads the stored proposal into the local 'prop'.
executeProposal marks executed, success and returnData on the proposals mapping.
the selector and parameters held in 'prop' are encoded and used for the arbitrary low-level call.
executeProposal performs prop.destination.call{value: prop.value}(payload) with an attacker-chosen target.
during the arbitrary call the board address is still the caller context, but onlyBoard functions require msg.sender == address(this), which the external destination cannot satisfy.
addBoardMember sets boardMembers[_newMember] = true, granting voting rights.
addBoardMember raises minVotes to 1 when the board grows and no quorum is set.
_newMember is the address added to the board.
removeBoardMember clears boardMembers[_member], revoking voting rights.
removeBoardMember clamps minVotes down to the remaining member count.
addProposalType writes a new function selector into the proposalTypes mapping.
_id is the name under which the selector is registered.
_signature is the bytes4 selector that proposals may then execute.
The payable _account can re-enter MBDAAsset during the value call made by burn.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the destination argument of MBDAAsset.transfer and should be folded into that core function node.
_value is the transfer amount consumed by MBDAAsset.transfer and has no independent existence.
_from is the debited account argument of transferFrom and collapses into that function node.
_spender is the allowance key argument of approve and should be normalized into it.
_account is the payable burn target and only exists inside MBDAAsset.burn.
_beneficiary is the call target of withdrawEther and is absorbed by it.
_amount directly parameterizes the value transfer performed by the withdrawEther low-level call.
_recipient is passed straight into the external token transfer performed by MBDAWallet.transfer.
_assetAddress determines the external contract address used by the wallet token call operation.
the local 'from' is a temporary remapping of msg.sender/admin used only within transfer.
the 'success' boolean is only the return flag of the burn value call operation.
_controller is the sole argument that newController writes into the controllers mapping.
_type is looked up in proposalTypes only inside addProposal.
_proposalID selects the proposal mutated by vote and has no meaning outside it.
the local 'prop' is the memory copy whose fields configure the executeProposal low-level call.
_fundManager is the admin parameter passed into the new MBDAAsset within newFund.
recipientExternalID is only used as the registration key inside CreateWallet.
_newMember is the address written into boardMembers by addBoardMember.
_id is only the mapping key of the selector registration in addProposalType.
_signature is the selector value stored by addProposalType and later reused by executeProposal.
the local newWallet is the freshly deployed instance handled entirely inside CreateWallet.
_destination is stored by addProposal and later consumed by the proposal execution call.
_value is stored by addProposal and later attached to the proposal execution call.
